notes: UNRESOLVED PLACEHOLDER. checksum_sha256 is the all-zeros sentinel (NOT a real SHA-256; it will never match any file). version, archive_filename, and origin_url are representative examples pending actual pinning and do not constitute a verified pin. SourceManager.prepare() refuses to proceed while status != 'pinned' via SourceLockUnresolvedError, so no build-kernel invocation can consume this lock until it is completed. To pin: (1) obtain the linux-source .deb for the intended kernel from a trusted Debian pool URL or an approved upstream source; (2) compute sha256sum of the retrieved archive; (3) set status to 'pinned' and replace checksum_sha256 with the verified hash; (4) set retrieved_date to today's ISO-8601 UTC date (e.g. 2026-11-12); (5) update version and archive_filename to match the obtained archive if they differ from the example values; (6) run 'huey-kernel plan --config kernel/huey-linux/build.yaml' to confirm the lock is consumed without warnings; (7) commit the updated lock in the same change set as the artifact that produced it.
